theme: Skia m152 with Graphite GPU bindings
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the engine to Skia m152 and adds early Graphite GPU backend bindings.
highlights_body: Alongside the milestone bump, this release fixes two native use-after-free bugs and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak, adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, and lands a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux.

bullets.detail: The bundled engine advances to Chrome milestone m152, picking up the upstream m151/m152 stability fixes merged during the preview.
Adds early bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, laying the groundwork for the next-generation GPU pipeline.
SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends instead of requiring backend-specific code.
A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package brings Silk.NET-based Vulkan interop, now exercised by Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux.
SKRegion.SpanIterator now roots its owning SKRegion, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* root their pixel source, closing native use-after-free crashes.
SKImage.Create no longer leaks its CoTaskMem pixel buffer when raster allocation fails.

bullets.lead: Allocation and lookup hot paths trimmed
bullets.detail: GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on its null-terminated path, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map, SKData.SaveTo drops a double buffer copy, and the handle dictionary skip-registration reflection check is now cached.

bullets.lead: FreeType powers Nano Server font support
bullets.detail: Nano Server containers now render text via FreeType instead of relying on a font stack that isn't available there.

bullets.lead: New containerized test legs and deterministic bindings
bullets.detail: Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containerized test legs, and makes binding generation deterministic across build platforms.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server (#1105).
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Initialized the MSVC environment once per native Windows build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Opened the m152 line with the Skia milestone bump, the Graphite GPU backend bindings, the async RequestReadPixels API, and the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package.

harfbuzz_summary: Converts the HarfBuzzSharp solution files to .slnx format and adds the containerized Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test legs.
